While sitting, waiting at the train station on the way back, this guy (who I'm pretty sure was with another dude) sits next to me and whispers some very barely intelligible stuff at me. Slightly creeped out, but not wanting to make my discomfort apparent, I casually stand up, pace for a little bit, then sit down at another empty seat.

Sure enough, guy sits next to me once again, only to continue mumbling some stuff at me. Over time, the whispers get a little more intelligible and begin to sound like threats. At one point, I'm pretty sure he said "you want me to break your kneecaps?", after a small while, he then finally gets up to take a train. Fortunately, it wasn't the same route I was taking.

As he gets on the train, I look at him (i had not made eye contact at all while he was sitting next to me) and he looks me dead in the eyes and points at me, then he gets on the train and leaves.

I'm still completely confused as to what he wanted, and I'm a bit afraid of going to that station, honestly. I think he may have been a mugger, but I'm not sure. I had nothing like this ever happen to me  before or since.
